entries.target: A short range attack that deals damage to 1 target.
entries.officialDescription: Strike your opponent with the unavoidable ebb of time, damaging them and reducing their Dodge by 25% for 5 seconds, and gaining a stack of Deadlock. Upon 8 stacks of Deadlock, consume them and Enter Infinity, increasing your Crit Chance by 20% for 3 seconds.
notes: Applies Infinite Hit to the target, reducing Dodge Chance by 25% for 5 seconds.
Applies Deadlock to the player, which stacks to 8 and lasts 10 seconds.
When used at 8 stacks of Deadlock, consumes 7 and applies Enter Infinity.
